exposure: Provider characteristics (age, gender, specialty, experience, practice type)
cohort: 37,692 births at NYU Langone Medical Center from 2005-2013
finding: Cesarean delivery rates varied widely among providers within the same institution and were associated with patient age, high-risk pregnancy, provider volume, and practice patterns, with forceps delivery rates being inversely correlated with cesarean delivery rates.
